name: 44842 · Loudonville, OH
findings: ZIP 44842 (Loudonville) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44842 (Loudonville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44842 (Loudonville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).
